children: Reserve Bank of New Zealand Gov. Anna Breman warns if oil prices remain elevated, inflation will overshoot the central bank's current forecasts. In a trip to Dunedin with other policymakers from the RBNZ, she noted that economic recovery is continuing, but that it remains "uneven." The recovery is expected to strengthen and broaden, reflecting a resilient export sector and gradual increase in household spending, she adds. (james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
